The {wiki:Hellgore} volcano erupts on the island of {wiki:Goroma}. During this Mini World Change, instead of the usual monsters, much stronger creatures appear inside the volcano, including {creature:Dragonling|Dragonlings}. Kill 50 fire creatures to earn the achievement **Fire from the Earth** and take the chance to tame a {item:Dragonling (Mount)|Dragonling}.
The Hellgore volcano erupts on Goroma.
No minimum level, but level 80+ is recommended: {creature:Demon|Demons} and {creature:Dragon Lord|Dragon Lords} appear.
The Mini World Change has to be active that day.
Access to Goroma: the *Access to Goroma* part of {wiki:The Shattered Isles Quest|The Shattered Isles Quest} (for {npc:Jack Fate}'s boat).
Plenty of health and mana potions.
Fire protection is useful: almost every creature attacks with fire.
500 gp for Jack Fate's boat to Goroma.
**Fire from the Earth** achievement (kill 50 fire creatures)
Stronger creatures (and better loot) inside the Hellgore
While the Mini World Change is active, {creature:Dragonling|Dragonlings} appear inside {wiki:Hellgore} and you can tame one.
The {creature:Demon|Demons} that appear during the event are very dangerous: go with a team if you are not a high level.
1. Find out whether the event is active

When the volcano erupts, this message appears: *"The volcano on Goroma sends his fiery message into the sky. A lot of creatures are flooding the lands together with its lava."* The town criers say: *"Hear ye! Hear ye! The volcano on Goroma is spitting fire. [...]"*

Travel to the island of {wiki:Goroma}, northwest of Liberty Bay: at the **Liberty Bay** port, talk to {npc:Jack Fate} on his boat and say {key:hi}, {key:goroma}, {key:yes} (500 gp). You land in the **east** of Goroma. Go to the {wiki:Hellgore} volcano. On the way you may meet {creature:Crab|Crabs}, {creature:Island Troll|Island Trolls}, {creature:Pirate Skeleton|Pirate Skeletons} and {creature:Pirate Ghost|Pirate Ghosts}.
Jack Fate's boat in the east of Goroma (arrival and return)
{npc:Jack Fate} will only take you to Goroma after the *Access to Goroma* part of {wiki:The Shattered Isles Quest|The Shattered Isles Quest}.

Instead of the usual {creature:Stone Golem|Stone Golems}, {creature:Fire Elemental|Fire Elementals} and {creature:Fire Devil|Fire Devils}, stronger creatures appear: {creature:Demon|Demons}, {creature:Diabolic Imp|Diabolic Imps}, {creature:Dragon|Dragons}, {creature:Dragon Hatchling|Dragon Hatchlings}, {creature:Dragon Lord|Dragon Lords}, {creature:Dragon Lord Hatchling|Dragon Lord Hatchlings}, {creature:Dragonling|Dragonlings} and {creature:Hellfire Fighter|Hellfire Fighters}.
Demons and Dragon Lords can easily kill low-level players.
Kill **50** fire creatures of any kind, on top of or inside the volcano. You earn the **Fire from the Earth** achievement.
This event is an excellent chance to tame your own {item:Dragonling (Mount)|Dragonling}, because {creature:Dragonling|Dragonlings} appear inside the volcano.
Leave the volcano the same way you came in and go back to {npc:Jack Fate}'s boat, in the **east** of Goroma. Say {key:hi}, {key:liberty bay}, {key:yes} to return to Liberty Bay.
If you get shipwrecked on Goroma (it can happen on a trip between Liberty Bay and Thais, from level 20), the only way out is to collect 30 {item:Wood} to repair the boat.
